EXPLORE SMART APPLICATIONS

Environmental Intelligence. Ready to Explore.

Access digital applications that bring environmental data to life through visual insights, monitoring information, maps, and environmental services.

AvatarEAD Avatar and chatbot are innovative AI-powered solution that enhances access to, and engagement with, environmental education through lifelike avatars Souheil and Dana, which are fluent in Arabic and English. It is powered by advanced AI using verified information for natural, reliable interaction. Transforms how EAD communicates with the public. Enhances accessibility to environmental education.Explore →ChatbotEAD Avatar and chatbot are innovative AI-powered solution that enhances access to, and engagement with, environmental education through lifelike avatars Souheil and Dana, which are fluent in Arabic and English. It is powered by advanced AI using verified information for natural, reliable interaction. Transforms how EAD communicates with the public. Enhances accessibility to environmental education.Explore →EnviroportalThe Enviroportal by the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi provides an interactive map that allows users to explore environmental data across the region. The portal offers spatial tools to analyze various datasets, such as biodiversity, water resources, and air quality, promoting transparency and informed decision-making for conservation efforts. Users can visualize environmental conditions in real-time, aiding both public awareness and scientific research.Explore →Air Quality PortalThe Abu Dhabi Air Quality website provides real-time data on air quality across the region, helping the public monitor air pollution levels through the Air Quality Index (AQI). It features interactive tools that track pollutants such as PM10, PM2.5, and NO2, with hourly updates on air quality trends. The platform offers insights on health recommendations based on AQI levels, pollutant sources, and weather conditions. Additionally, it promotes awareness of sustainable practices to improve air quality.Explore →Abu Dhabi NatureThe Abu Dhabi Nature platform, managed by the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD), is dedicated to showcasing the biodiversity of the region. It provides users with detailed information on native species, habitats, and conservation efforts across Abu Dhabi. The platform promotes awareness of the emirate’s rich natural heritage through interactive tools, species guides, and educational resources. It supports both public users and researchers in understanding the region's unique ecosystems and the importance of preserving them.Explore →NahaThe Naha platform, powered by the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD), is a community-driven initiative that transforms climate intentions into meaningful actions. It offers resources, tools, and personalized journeys to help users adopt sustainable practices and make informed environmental decisions. With a focus on engaging youth and the community, Naha aligns individual efforts with broader climate goals, supporting the UAE's sustainability vision. The platform fosters collaboration, knowledge sharing, and celebrates achievements in conservation and environmental action.Explore →Al DaleelaThe Al Daleela platform is a comprehensive mapping tool that provides users with access to a wide array of geospatial data for the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. It allows users to explore maps, track environmental changes, and analyze various geographic features across the region. The platform offers an interactive experience to view points of interest, land use, and environmental conservation efforts, supporting research, planning, and conservation activities.Explore →Bird Tracking SystemThe Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi's Bird Tracking Information System uses telemetry to monitor migratory birds such as flamingos and raptors. Since 2005, it has tracked various species, providing vital migration data through secure storage and analysis. This supports bird conservation, long-term data preservation, and scientific research, though data access is mostly restricted.Explore →National Fisheries Information SystemThe UAE National Fisheries Information System (NFIS) is a platform designed for the statistical monitoring of fisheries in the UAE, managed by the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi. It provides data summaries, insights, and methodology details for public use. Restricted sections of the platform are accessible only with valid credentials, offering advanced functionalities for authorized users to monitor and manage fisheries data.Explore →Oil Spill MonitoringDetection of oil spill using SAR imageryExplore →Marine DebrisAI model to detect and monitor marine debris using satellite imagery.Explore →Algal BloomAI model to identify and map algal blooms using satellite data.Explore →Outfall MonitoringMonitoring of the outfall locations using satellite imageryExplore →Fish Species IdentificationAI Detection for classification of fishes in underwater videos.Explore →Birds, Nests and Animal Identification and CountingAI models for identification and counting of various species of Birds,nests and animals.Explore →Jaywun HabitatAI Detection for classification of marine habitats in underwater videosExplore →Land Subsidence ModellingLand deformation maps for agreed upon areas.Explore →Change DetectionAI model for Change detection using satellite imageryExplore →Dredges DetectionAI model to detect and track dredging activities in water bodies.Explore →Urban DetectionMonitors and maps urban growth and development using satellite imagery and AI analysis.Explore →Coastline Change DetectionQuantifies changes in coastlines over time, providing geo-referenced outputs for monitoring.Explore →Vegetation DetectionDetects and maps vegetation cover using remote sensing and AI models for environmental monitoring.Explore →Tree Species DetectionAI model for tree detection using satelite imageryExplore →Camera Trap Analysis Species MonitoringAI model for detection of various species captured in Camera Traps during surveyExplore →

ABOUT THE PLATFORM

A Trusted Source for Environmental Data.

The Environmental Data Platform is Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi's central destination for environmental data discovery, access, and exploration.

By bringing together environmental datasets, applications, and information resources, the platform supports researchers, policymakers, organisations, and the public in developing a clearer understanding of Abu Dhabi's environment.

Connecting Data. Enabling Understanding.

Learn More About EDP
Environmental Data Platform
HELP & SUPPORT

Have Questions? Start Here.

The Environmental Data Platform is a central digital destination for discovering and accessing environmental information related to Abu Dhabi.

You can explore available datasets covering air quality, water resources, marine environments, biodiversity, climate, land, and other environmental themes.

The platform is designed to support environmental information discovery for researchers, government entities, organisations, and members of the public, subject to applicable access permissions.

Where geospatial visualisation is supported, environmental information can be explored through interactive maps and geographical views.

Use the platform's search and data catalogues to locate relevant datasets. Available access and download options depend on the selected resource.

Dataset accessibility may vary depending on publication status, information sensitivity, and applicable data access policies.
